feeds.title: Sustainably Chic
feeds.description: Sustainable fashion, beauty & lifestyle blog by Natalie Kay. Featuring eco-friendly & ethically made clothing, skincare and home decor for the conscious consumer.

feeds.title: Eco-Stylist Blog
feeds.description: Get practical men's style advice, eco-conscious brand recommendations, and ethical fashion news. Plus the latest and greatest from Eco-Stylist.

feeds.title: Conscious Life and Style
feeds.description: Conscious Life and Style contains resources that support a slow and eco-conscious lifestyle, curate responsible fashion & lifestyle brands; share educational content for diving deeper into systemic causes of the various global challenges we face in fashion and beyond; and explore solutions that will bring about a better, more equitable and sustainable future.

feeds.title: The Peahen
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Kasi. The Peahen is a source for approachable, ethical fashion. It publishes guides, opinions & interviews and reports with a dash of sass.

feeds.title: The Green Hub
feeds.description: A sustainable fashion and lifestyle hub designed to help you navigate the urban green living jungle and be inspired to live a little more sustainably.

feeds.title: The Wellness Feed
feeds.description: The Wellness Feed launched as a lifestyle and news publication devoted to the wellness and eco-friendly scene. Created by a journalist TWF answers readers' questions about living sustainably with educational and call-to-action articles.

feeds.title: Thrifts + Tangles Blog
feeds.description: Tyler Chanel is the creator behind Thrifts & Tangles. Thrifts and Tangles began in 2012 as a way for Tyler to document her natural hair journey. After receiving several questions about her secondhand clothing from friends and family, she expanded into sharing thrifted fashion. Follow her blog, which provides educational tips and resources to encourage millennial women to give thrifting, sustainability, and their natural selves a chance.

feeds.title: Centre for Sustainable Fashion Blog
feeds.description: We are the Centre for Sustainable Fashion (CSF), a University of the Arts London research, education, and knowledge exchange center. Our work explores vital elements of Better Lives London College of Fashion's commitment to using fashion to drive change, build a sustainable future, and improve the way we live. CSF was devised to question and challenge reactionary fashion cultures, which reflect and re-enforce patterns of excessive consumption and disconnection, to expand fashion's ability to connect, delight, and identify individual and collective values.

feeds.title: Style Wise
feeds.description: Leah Wise runs Style Wise, a blog dedicated to ethical style, slow living, and sustainable fashion brands. All things fair trade, artisan made, made in USA, and eco-friendlys.

feeds.title: Ethical Fashion Guatemala Blog
feeds.description: Ethical Fashion Guatemala Blog provides the latest news covering Ethical Fashion in Guatemala, United States, Canada, Europe, and Asia.

feeds.title: Ms. Paula Presents
feeds.description: I'm an NYC mom of two, with a deep commitment to fostering sustainable fashion, which also encompasses vintage and thrift. On my blog, I hope to inspire more people to consider sustainable fashion choices and generally a sustainable lifestyle by providing easy-to-follow steps and information.

feeds.title: Ecocult
feeds.description: EcoCult is stunningly informed, brash, beautiful and unapologetic. EcoCult loves anything local, sustainable, eco-friendly, handmade. Living sustainably just makes sense to me, even though it's not always easy.

feeds.title: My Green Closet
feeds.description: Hey, there. I'm Verena Erin. Thanks for dropping by! My Green Closet is a blog and community about slow fashion, sustainability, and living more aligned with your values. Here you'll find guides, resources, tips, and thought-pieces to help you on your personal journey.

feeds.title: Style Bee
feeds.description: Style Bee is the creative hive of Lee Vosburgh, where she endeavors to explore the definition of personal style and share the best independent makers and brands from around the globe. Through Style Bee, Lee aims to inspire readers to shop thoughtfully with careful consideration about every purchase. The better we know ourselves, the better our choices will be!

feeds.title: The Fashion Advocate Blog
feeds.description: The Fashion Advocate is a Melbourne-based blog, magazine, and online store, supporting Australian-made fashion, beauty, and lifestyle brands. We share stories from all over Australia on our blog with creators and makers who are moving and shaking in the ethical and sustainable space, and we feature interviews with emerging and established designers who have inspiring tales to tell.

feeds.title: Econosa
feeds.description: Econosa is your number one source for all things sustainable, eco-friendly, and fair trade-related and are dedicated to giving you the very best of information, with a focus on where to find eco-friendly and sustainable products and tips.

feeds.title: The Green Edition
feeds.description: An online magazine full of tips and tricks for curating a sustainable and ethical wardrobe. Also featuring sustainable travel guides.

feeds.title: Ecothes
feeds.description: This website was created out of a desire to wear clothes that not only look good, but are created in a sustainable way.

feeds.title: IndieGetup Blog
feeds.description: IndieGetup is the best resource for finding innovative, ethically-sourced and local clothing brands on the internet. Discover the difference. Wear the best.

feeds.title: Fashionhedge
feeds.description: Fashionhedge was born with the mission of creating a useful resource to learn about ethical fashion. We find ethical and sustainable fashion brands that are well made and weed out all the terrible products that sometimes are bundled in those categories. FashionHedge aims to fill a void in the slow fashion movement, providing relevant content to inform readers about the ideals of ethical fashion.

feeds.title: Glamourina
feeds.description: Enter the fashion blog written by Natalia Viktorovna fashion stylist. The fashion blog is eco-friendly and vegan.

feeds.title: FASHION me GREEN Blog
feeds.description: FASHION me GREEN by Greta Eagan offers style tips, eco-styling services, expert advice and strategy around sustainability, and gladly explores brand collaborations that further awareness around conscious living with style standards as high as the eco ones.

feeds.title: Fashion Hound

feeds.title: RecoverGirl

feeds.title: leafable

feeds.title: Beyoutiful Hope

feeds.title: Chic Vegan » Fashion
feeds.description: Chic vegan keeps you on the forefront of ethical and eco-friendly living. We provide all the latest and greatest information on vegan life.

feeds.title: Sustainable Fashion Matterz Blog
feeds.description: Sustainable Fashion Blog for Industry Insights. Who and What you need to know! Fashion Activism | Interviews | Innovative, Ethical, Fair, Slow, Vegan & Sustainable Brands. Visit Events and Build Your Network With Us.

feeds.title: GirlieGirl Army

feeds.title: My Beauty Bunny
feeds.description: My Beauty Bunny is a an award winning, Los Angeles based top beauty blog about cruelty free beauty products along with fashion for guys and gals who can't get enough hair, skin, makeup and other beauty products not tested on animals.

feeds.title: Upasana
feeds.description: Our mission is to create conscious sustainable fashion where we are taking care of our environmental cost and not passing it on to the future.

feeds.title: Anke Wonder LLC Blog
feeds.description: Wear a piece of art - that's the motto of my brand. Hi! I am Anke Wonder, an Independent Fashion Designer, focussing on unique, colorful, vegan, sustainable, ethical and beautiful fashion for men and women. My ethical fashion and lifestyle blog offers resources on how to live a healthier and more conscious life. You can expect every month a new article about innovations, changes and myths in the fashion industry that also highlight facts and practices around environmentally important topics.

feeds.title: Sustainably Kind Living
feeds.description: Founded by Danielle Alvarado, Sustainably Kind Living is a sustainable fashion and lifestyle website dedicated to educating and inspiring people to become conscious consumers - starting with simply using what they already own!

feeds.title: Eluxe Magazine

After it got underway I quickly became immersed in the world of ethical fashion.
